tools.name: token_get_by_uuid
tools.description: Get a token's platform, sale status, price, rate and issuer. Tokens have no tickers; find the id with token_list. Example: {"uuid":"78c7e502"}.

tools.name: token_list
tools.description: Browse active tokenized securities by platform or sale status; returns tokens and next_cursor. Tokens have no tickers. Example: {"platform":"finstore","limit":20}.

tools.name: share_get_by_uuid
tools.description: Get a BCSE share's ticker, issuer, nominal value and trading-today flag. Resolve tickers with search_by_ticker first. Example: {"uuid":"a97f1fed"}.

tools.name: share_list
tools.description: List active BCSE shares by issuer and trading-today status; returns shares and next_cursor. Use an issuer row from search_by_name. Example: {"issuer_uuid":"0d3bf3be","limit":20}.

tools.name: share_payouts_get
tools.description: Get a share's dividend events and declared-payout summary. dividend_yield_pct uses nominal value, not market price; no_dividend/cancelled events are excluded from money totals. Example: {"uuid":"a97f1fed"}.

tools.name: bond_get_by_uuid
tools.description: Get a BCSE bond's ticker, issuer, coupon, maturity and trading-today flag. Resolve tickers with search_by_ticker first. Example: {"uuid":"76f01f65"}.

tools.name: bond_list
tools.description: List active BCSE bonds by issuer and trading-today status; returns bonds and next_cursor. Use an issuer row from search_by_name. Example: {"issuer_uuid":"45aca6f7","limit":20}.

tools.name: company_get_by_uuid
tools.description: Get a company catalogue row, including name, UNP, industry and activity flag; includes inactive companies. Find company IDs with search_by_name. Example: {"uuid":"730f9a9e"}.

tools.name: company_list
tools.description: Browse active companies by industry; returns companies and next_cursor, not issuer rows. For issuers use search_by_name. Example: {"limit":20}.

tools.name: search_by_ticker
tools.description: Find BCSE shares/bonds by ticker substring; returns entity_type and TokenBel uuid for detail or trading tools. Tokens have no tickers. Example: {"query":"ASB"}.

tools.name: search_by_name
tools.description: Find companies and securities issuers by name or UNP; results tag entity_type. Use company uuid for company_get_by_uuid, issuer uuid for share_list/bond_list; linked_company_uuid joins them when known. Example: {"query":"Агрофинанс"}.

tools.name: currency_rate_get
tools.description: Get NBRB FX rates in BYN per 1 USD/EUR/RUB. No dates = latest; date = one day; date_from/date_to = range; group_by + both bounds = weekly/monthly averages. Example: {"currency":"usd","date":"2026-06-18"}.

tools.name: trading_stats_get
tools.description: Get share/bond trading totals and daily_series. No dates = latest 30 days; both dates = range (yield_wavg and *_latest are null). Find the id with search_by_ticker. Example: {"uuid":"a97f1fed","date_from":"2026-06-01","date_to":"2026-06-30"}.

tools.name: token_trading_stats_get
tools.description: Get a token's primary-market tokens-sold daily series, totals and snapshot; not secondary trading. No dates = last 30 days; either date bound is allowed. Find the id with token_list. Example: {"uuid":"78c7e502"}.

tools.name: company_financial_params_get
tools.description: Get a company's financial statement metrics and ratios, newest periods first. Accepts a company or linked issuer id from search_by_name. Example: {"uuid":"311ff09f","limit_periods":4}.

tools.name: company_tokens_list
tools.description: List a company's active token summary cards and next_cursor. Accepts a company or linked issuer id. Example: {"uuid":"7b860c81","limit":20}.

tools.name: company_shares_list
tools.description: List a company's active share summary cards and next_cursor. Accepts a company or linked issuer id. Example: {"uuid":"0d3bf3be","limit":20}.

tools.name: company_bonds_list
tools.description: List a company's active bond summary cards and next_cursor. Accepts a company or linked issuer id. Example: {"uuid":"0d3bf3be","limit":20}.

tools.name: entity_news_list
tools.description: List published news across a company/issuer and linked securities; returns events with links, tags and next_cursor. Filter by event/impact type or date. Example: {"uuid":"f2c03989","impact_types":["negative"]}.
